scope: Broad overhead screen: all fixed partitions/trees with a bounded split grid, not fully tuned strongest methods or an application claim
persistent_fixed_ablation_definition: Fixed M32 persistent rows retain extra masked MMA work versus compact dynamic rows; fullcol_guard/persistent is not a pure state-transport-only change.
best_bank_control_definition: Fastest qualified required family excluding v4, lane_select and owner_tasks. Original bankpilot control grid is retained.
best_lane_control_definition: Fastest qualified prior non-lane required family, excluding owner_tasks and including v4, wide FullCol, persistent, FullCol, v2/v3, native/E1/E4.
best_owner_control_definition: Fastest qualified non-owner required family; includes complete native/E1/E4, dynamic v2/v3/emptyguard, FullCol, persistent, wide, lane and four qualified static-v4 points.
owner_grid_expansion_definition: Original six owner configurations retained exactly; add chunks64/128/2048/4096 at N32/N64 for fourteen owner points. Every non-owner lane55/87 configuration remains unchanged.
owner_splits_semantics: splits=64 is an accepted compatibility parameter only and is not used to partition tasks; chunk_tokens=64/128/256/512/1024/2048/4096 determines each owner-cohort chunk.
owner_comparison_scope: Immutable owner topology: same plan for each timed CUDA graph. No dynamic-topology update, rebuild or recapture is hidden inside steady-state latency; complete prepare is measured separately.
owner_graph_topology_contract: Q/K/V/Indices may change in place; offsets/labels/counts/row_map changes require rebuilding task descriptors and CUDA graph recapture. External graph.replay bypasses host version checks.
owner_factorial_ablation_status: The 2x2 uniform-split/chunk-task by rectangular/packed-partial matrix is incomplete. Owner versus region_partials changes both task partitioning and partial storage and is not a pure packing ablation.
lane_v4_control_grid_coverage: Four of six split/N points: original split64/N32,N64 plus previously qualified B3 split128/N32,N64 or B4 split32/N32 and split128/N64; not a full grid.

provenance.decode_step_definition: s1 is each actual suffix-prefill query predicting first generated token (selector compatibility only); s16/s64/s256 are same-forward ready-group snapshots anchored on question0 prediction step, with each request's own actual position retained
provenance.mask_definition: Budget applies to the full original document; protected partial-page document tail resides in private suffix and is omitted from common-source masks only. All original selected tokens remain in execution. Derived 64K/128K/full supports use identical frozen suffix-only scores; requests exceeding document length are explicitly clipped to full. The filename budget is a request, not the realized token count.

oracle_scope: Per-capture hindsight latency oracle among the measured grid; not a deployed plan selector.

limitations: Hierarchical split partial output is native BF16 and merged with FP32 log2-LSE weights; every tested configuration is separately qualified.
E4 uses exact binary-tree intersection/residual decomposition with all nodes batched, not the original QUILT code/planner.
Only shared-source KV is zero-copy; query gathering, normalized output restoration and hierarchical merge are included in run().
Plan preparation and actual prepare+one-run wall time are measured; search is reported separately, not silently amortized away.
Same-capture hot/cold controls do not establish common-ready overlap, generation quality, full-model speedup or energy improvement.
Persistent fixed-M32 versus compact FullCol changes masked MMA work; do not attribute the whole difference solely to state transport.

Lane uses a six-point split/N grid; lane mode strengthens v4 controls to four previously qualified points, while bankpilot mode retains its original two. A v4/lane family comparison alone does not isolate code structure from tuning-grid coverage.
Owner-task uses immutable topology and fixed token chunks, unlike dynamic equal splits. A changed topology requires explicit rebuild and graph recapture; graph.replay bypasses the host guard.
Uniform-split/chunk-task by rectangular/packed partial 2x2 is incomplete; owner-task versus region_partials is not a pure packing or state-transport ablation.
Owner workspace includes all owned descriptor/merge/output buffers. Legacy controls report U/M/L partial buffers; row workspace_scope and separate RegionPlan bytes prevent equal-scope assumptions.
Bankpilot retains the full control grid but tests v4 at only split64/N32 and split64/N64; it is not a full v4 tuning or an application result.
